subject.title: [Feature Request] Add option to disable 'new messages' notification banner in WebChat

question: Should WebChat permit the manual New messages catch-up action to be hidden, and if so what visible recovery path must remain when auto-scroll is off?
rationale: The action is not merely decorative: it is the existing route back to the live tail when WebChat intentionally preserves backscroll, so source inspection cannot determine the acceptable UX tradeoff.

options.title: Compact or dismissible action
options.body: Keep a smaller or dismissible scroll-to-latest affordance so long responses remain readable without removing recovery entirely.

options.title: Browser-local hide toggle
options.body: Allow hiding the action through persisted UI settings, but provide another visible or keyboard-accessible scroll-to-latest control.

options.title: Keep current behavior
options.body: Retain the always-visible action whenever unseen messages exist and make no additional setting.

recommendation.title: Compact or dismissible action
recommendation.body: Keep a smaller or dismissible scroll-to-latest affordance so long responses remain readable without removing recovery entirely.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent work and prior review connect them most directly to both the WebChat implementation and the product-level recovery-affordance choice.
